name: Центральный громкоговоритель Quad S-C2
descriptionHtml:
Центральный громкоговоритель Quad S-C2 — S-C2 is a 2-way centre speaker.

  • Description: 2-way centre speaker
  • Enclosure: Vented box loudspeaker
  • Bass/midrange driver: 2 × 125 mm woven Kevlar
  • Treble driver: 12 × 45 mm true ribbon
  • Sensitivity: 89 dB (2.83 V @ 1 m)

Характеристики

Description: 2-way centre speaker · Enclosure: Vented box loudspeaker · Bass/midrange driver: 2 × 125 mm woven Kevlar · Treble driver: 12 × 45 mm true ribbon · Sensitivity: 89 dB (2.83 V @ 1 m) · Recommended amplifier power: 25–150 W · Impedance: 8 Ω nominal; 5.6 Ω minimum · Frequency response: 55 Hz–20 kHz (±3 dB).

It uses two 125 mm woven Kevlar bass/midrange drivers and a 12 × 45 mm true-ribbon treble driver.
